text:
alex: Heads up — onboarding sampleapp hit a weird parity snag between Node and Python SDKs when using the new batch helper. Node pads vectors with zeros differently and rerank responses end up with inconsistent shapes.

mira: oof. any logs?

alex: pasted a minimal repro below. Node requests include `pad_to` in the helper and Python uses `pad_to_max` (oops). Behavior: Node sends extra float entries, Python trims. Downstream cosine similarity fails.

sam: can you paste the request/response?

alex: sure — Node request payload:```json
{
  "model": "embed-lite-v1",
  "vectors": [[0.1,0.2,0.3]],
  "pad_to": 384,
  "metadata": {"id":"u1"}
}
```Python request payload:```json
{
  "model": "embed-lite-v1",
  "vectors": [[0.1,0.2,0.3]],
  "pad_to_max": 384,
  "metadata": {"id":"u1"}
}
```Node response snippet:```json
{"embedding": [0.01,0.02,...,0.0,0.0]} // length 384
```Python response snippet:```json
{"embedding": [0.01,0.02,...]} // length 256
```

mira: that explains the downstream mismatch. Looks like pad param name diverged during the batch helper refactor. Where did the helper live?

jules: it lives in `sdk/batch_helpers` in both repos — PR #1234 renamed the option to be 'pad_to' everywhere but we missed the Python binding.

alex: PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1234

sdk-qa: repro steps: 1) run sampleapp Node `yarn start` 2) call /embed-batch with arrays of varying lengths 3) run python sampleapp and compare lengths. Intermittent retry behavior can amplify the issue: Python retryer re-sends the unpadded request on 409 and gets a shorter vector, Node retry returns padded vector -> duplicates in DB.

sam: ah the idempotency/retry mismatch. Are retry headers consistent?

alex: Node sets `Idempotency-Key` header, Python used `X-Request-Id` for internal retry but doesn't translate to the server header for idempotency.

mira: that can cause double-inserts. We should: 1) unify pad param name, 2) align retry header mapping, 3) add a vector-dim sanity check in the client that errors early.

jules: agree. I'll open a quick follow-up to add client-side assertion that all embeddings returned in a batch share the same length and that it matches expected pad.

sdk-qa: also adding an integration test that runs Node+Python sampleapps together and compares embedding lengths across 50 randomized inputs.

alex: small config suggestion for the batch helper docs: show explicit example of `pad_to: 384` and the server's `embedding.dim` in the response. People kept assuming variable-length output is okay.

mira: can someone own the hotfix? This is affecting a customer POC.

jules: I'll pick it up and do a quick patch to python binding + test. ETA 2h.

dev-bot: deploy: edge patch branch `hotfix/py-padparam` deployed to staging (build 789).

sam: when hotfix is in, we should backfill a migration for duplicate DB rows created by the retry mismatch. I'll draft a short script.

alex: thanks. one more tiny note — re-rerank responses include `scores` array that sometimes gets returned as strings from an older Python client (float->string conversion). Might be unrelated but worth adding a schema check on the client.

mira: added to the checklist. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

alex: TL;DR: parity bug between SDKs (pad param name + retry header mismatch) causing embedding dim mismatch and duplicate inserts. Jules on hotfix, sdk-qa adding integration test, sam prepping DB cleanup.

sdk-qa: will post results from staging run in ~30m.
